instruction: Extract and consolidate code from all code cells in this Colab notebook, insert a header comment with the total line count ('# Total lines: N'), and write the result to 'notebook_code.py' in the Home directory.

rules.has_line_count_comment: File must have a comment in first 10 lines showing total line count (e.g., '# Total lines: N')
rules.line_count_accurate: The claimed line count must match actual code lines (±2 tolerance)
rules.has_executable_code: File must contain actual Python code (not just comments)
rules.appears_from_notebook: Code should have characteristics of notebook code (imports, functions, or multiple logical blocks)
